verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's docs say its Logfire telemetry integration is 'built-in (but optional)'. Agent-run data is sent only if the logfire package is installed and configured and instrumentation is enabled, so this telemetry path is opt-in and can be left off. The evidence covers only this observability integration, not product usage tracking in general. missing for 10: a statement on whether the library or the clai CLI collects any usage analytics, a documented explicit opt-out switch or env var, a privacy or telemetry policy page, and independent corroboration that no data is sent by default.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Pydantic AI has built-in (but optional) support for Logfire. That means if the logfire package is installed and configured and agent instrumentation is enabled then detailed information about agent runs is sent to Logfire.
